findings.text: The fragment duplicates an already-landed evidence record rather than extending it: docs/evidence/fragments/an-orchestrator-can-discharge-a-refusal/preserve-ordinary-resume-after-a-lane-change.html:2 carries the same h2 'An ordinary resume finds the session a lane change started' and the same tests/test_lane_change_keeps_resume_identity.py verification, and because the two files have distinct node ids reckon/evidence.py:1915 compose_landed_record composes both into §10's cumulative record, so the published evidence page will show the section's verification twice under one heading. The reviewed node's own contract says a routine landing writes no fragment (prompt.txt, CONTRACT — LANDING YOUR RECORD). Non-blocking because the fragment is accurate, its figures reconcile with logs/gate-head.log and logs/negative-control.log, and the duplication corrupts nothing.
